blk_part_01_part_1_friendly_words_with_a.text: These words are not only fun. They tell us something about values. Australian society cares about informality, which means a relaxed and not-too-formal style. It also cares about equality. Here, equality means that no one should act more important than other people. Friendly words help people feel like equals. They show the idea of "mateship." This means friendship, loyalty and looking after each other.

blk_part_04_part_4_work_relaxed_style_re.text: Australian workplaces are usually closer to the second office. They are informal and egalitarian. "Egalitarian" means people are treated as equals, without a strong ladder of who is more important. This is not an accident. Workplaces follow the same values as the wider society. They are informal and they care about equality, just like the friendly language in Part 1.
